newsitem.title: USA: Substance Abuse says developing saliva test.
newsitem.headline: Substance Abuse says developing saliva test.

text.p: Substance Abuse Technologies Inc said Wednesday it is expanding its saliva-based drug-testing technology to include a simultaneous test for alcohol.
The test is currently under development and is expected to come to market within 18 months.
The company said it believed it would be first to market with a non-invasive combination drug and alcohol test.
Substance Abuse also said it will begin marketing its AlcoProof System, a new product that meets industry's immediate need for quantitative and qualitative on-site alcohol testing via the breath.
The company said it will conduct a nationwide conference call on March 27 at 1000 EST/1500 GMT. Anyone wishing to participate, please call 1-800-553-3587 approximately 10 minutes prior to the call.
